pre_execution_amendment.reason: The formal runner correctly refused a 4096 MB worker because it exceeded 80% of then-available physical memory. Before any admissible formal result existed, the cap was reduced to 3072 MB and all protocol/design/power/release hashes were regenerated.

analysis_contract.estimand_A_fixed_benchmark: finite-population paired causal ATE conditional on the frozen 391 unique input hashes; input hash is the repeated-measure block and family is a fixed blocking/heterogeneity stratum
analysis_contract.estimand_B_new_family: equal-family-weighted generalized ATE for a super-population of potentially unseen circuit families; family is the independent cluster
analysis_contract.repeated_measure: all treatment cells applied to each unique input hash
analysis_contract.primary_contrast: equal-weight mean over all 3 window_gates x 4 budget_seconds cells of [(WCL-LBL)_COMMUTATION_PLUS_TEMPLATES - (WCL-LBL)_COMMUTATION_ONLY]
supportive_contrasts: listing_model main effects averaged over all other factors
rule_set main effect averaged over all other factors
prespecified two-way interactions other than the primary listing-by-rule_set contrast
the same primary contrast under estimand_B_new_family
analysis_contract.random_listing_role: prespecified placebo/sensitivity listing, not an independent circuit instance
analysis_contract.multiplicity: exactly one confirmatory test at alpha 0.05; supportive and exploratory contrasts cannot be relabelled confirmatory
analysis_contract.fixed_benchmark_inference: paired family-blocked Monte Carlo randomization (or exact enumeration when feasible), with a family-blocked interval; conditions on the frozen hashes and cannot support unseen-family language
analysis_contract.new_family_inference: family-level interval/test with 15 independent family clusters; input rows cannot supply cluster degrees of freedom

power_gate.formal_execution_scope: licensed only for the fixed shared-391 benchmark primary; no generalized new-family confirmatory claim
